verdict.rationale: The service page states availability up front: 'Pode criar uma empresa em qualquer momento' (you can create a company at any time). It also publishes the time windows that bind the flow: a 24-hour name reservation until the payment step, 48 hours to pay after submission, 5 consecutive days to fix non-conformities, and 30 days to file beneficial-owner data. However, nothing addresses a session timeout or any per-day submission limit, which are two of the three things the story asks about. Missing for 10: a published session-timeout/inactivity-logout policy, an explicit statement on per-day limits (or that none exist), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the service is really available around the clock.
